name: org-hint-by-name
description:
organization_hint given as a NAME rather than an id. CONFIG documents the parameter as "organization ID or name", and the name form was silently ignored: looks_numeric() answered false, choose_org_id() fell through to orgs[0] for the package read, and the device listing dropped the hint entirely. An operator who typed their organization's name got a DIFFERENT organization's inventory, with nothing in the log to say the value had been disregarded -- the worst shape a configuration error can take, because the run reports success.

"Northwind Retail" is the second organization in the /orgs response, deliberately, so resolving it cannot be confused with falling back to the first. Its id 7002 must reach both the package read and the `o=` parameter on the device listing, and the resolution must be logged. Matching is case-insensitive, which is why the hint is typed in a different case from the record.

The companion `org-hint` scenario covers the numeric form and asserts that /orgs is never called for it; this one is its mirror.

namespaced_ids is skipped: ids are the bare org-local device number, the pre-existing defect the other automox scenarios record.

log_contains: automox: organization_hint 'northwind retail' resolved to org id 7002
